name: Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
In another bowl whisk milk, egg and melted butter.
Fold wet into dry until just combined; leave lumps. Rest 5 min.
Cook 1/4-cup pools on a medium, lightly greased pan.
Flip when bubbles form and the edges set; cook until golden.
notes: Makes about 8 pancakes. Don't overmix. For buttermilk, swap the milk and add a pinch of baking soda.
